recipe.text:
Park any pre-existing StarterPack Tools into ServerStorage first; restore them after staging.
Build a 6-part dagger in Workspace: Grip cylinder + brass ball Pommel + small brass Guard bar + stubby steel Blade (0.42 x 1.5 x 0.14) + two mirrored WedgeParts forming a centered tip — the silhouette must read stubby-and-pointed, distinct from a sword or spear.
make_tool with the Grip as handle (welds + unanchors the other 5 parts), then move the Tool to StarterPack.
bind_behavior windup 0.08 / active 0.1 / cooldown 0.22 — a dagger is FASTER than the 0.15/0.15/0.4 defaults; bind_hitbox reach 4.5 / damage 8 / server cooldown 0.35, keeping the hit cooldown just under the 0.40s swing period so it never blocks a legitimate swing.
Re-read the Behavior*/Hit* attributes off the Tool to confirm the binds persisted before handing off to VERIFY.
Known gap: no use-animation clip is bound (bind_behavior warns) — run bind_animation later for a visible swing; state machine + hitbox work regardless.
